name: berberis vulgaris root bark + bos taurus nasal mucosa + silicon dioxide
purpose: Use: Temporary relief of sinus congestion.
otcwarn: Warnings: Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a physician if symptoms worsen. If pregnant or nursing, consult a physician before use. KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated.
